name: TeamStarWolf - Iran-Attributed Threat Actors Case Study (ICS)
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. The 24 ATT&CK for ICS techniques that ATT&CK v20.0 links to G1027 CyberAv3ngers, G0049 OilRig and G0064 APT33, bound in case-studies/THREAT_ACTORS_IRAN.md. Score = number of those groups linked to the technique.

legendItems.label: Score = Iran-attributed groups linked in the ATT&CK for ICS record

metadata.name: tactic_policy
metadata.value: Each selected technique is shown under all tactics it has in the library's ICS technique profiles. This is display expansion, not a claim that every tactic applies to the procedure.
